name: Remove nodes from tract profiles
summary: Trims tract profiles in a tractmeasures table to a given number of central nodes, removing an equal number of nodes from each end, using pandas.
description: Utility that keeps the num_nodes central nodes of every tract profile, dropping (total_nodes - num_nodes)/2 nodes at each end, and writes a new tractmeasures CSV. Use it to remove the noisy profile ends near tract terminations before group statistics.

inputs.description: Tract profiles table (tractmeasures.csv) with a nodeID column.

outputs.description: Tractmeasures CSV containing only the retained central nodes.

parameters.description: Number of nodes you'd like to keep in your profiles. Will remove the first and last (total_nodes - num_nodes) / 2
